g.text: What it shows: The most prominent concrete output of each conversation, across Anthropic's 32 artifact labels. 16 of 32

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Anthropic's published Economic Index data documentation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: 'None' is a real category and a large one: a substantial share of conversations produce no artifact at all, which is a conversation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: rather than a piece of work. Claude.ai covers the Free, Pro and Max consumer plans plus Cowork; Anthropic's API traffic is a separate

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: file and is not included here. A cell Anthropic did not publish is absent, not zero: a value is released only where it clears an

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: aggregation threshold and a geography sample floor.
